jamie_cs: quick async — PioneerLane renewal in 9 days. Last night their sandbox started retrying delivery webhooks ~10x which doubled token costs. What I did: checked delivery UI, disabled retries for sandbox, opened support ticket with PLC. Blocker: our logs only keep 5d for that org so need eng help to pull raw delivery traces and correlate req_id. Any tips? @leo_eng @sophia_csm

leo_eng: can you paste a sample req_id / error lines? also do we know if it's 5xx or client aborts?

jamie_cs: sample from the delivery UI: ```2026-03-16T22:11:02Z ERROR deliver.go:142 retrying webhook (status=502) req_id=abc123 org=pioneerlane attempts=4 path=/v1/embeds/callback```

leo_eng: thanks. 502 usually means upstream gateway. I'll pull traces from the logging cluster for req_id=abc123. If you can reproduce steps to trigger that webhook, ping me.

sophia_csm: fyi PioneerLane said they rolled out a canary to their proxy yesterday around 21:50 UTC, they suspect the change. They asked if we can cap retries to 3 while they investigate.

jamie_cs: I disabled retries for their sandbox but prod is still at 5 attempts — wanted to avoid doing a blunt change without eng signoff.

mike_oncall: I can apply a temporary per-org retry cap via feature-flagger. will push a scoped change (prod only) and monitor. command I'll run: ```curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/v1/flag -d '{"org":"pioneerlane","flag":"webhook_retries","value":3}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SVC_TOKEN'```

triage-bot: alert created: #INC-2026-1543 PioneerLane webhook surge — assigned leo_eng, mike_oncall — https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-1543

leo_eng: pulled traces, quick summary: majority of failures are 502 from their LB (10.0.5.22), window 22:10–22:30 UTC. Pattern: increased latency -> timeouts -> retries that pile up. Not seeing any obvious server-side NRE on our side.

jamie_cs: thanks. I'll hold renewal outreach until we have a mitigation. Once mike confirms the flag and we see error drop, I'll draft a short note for the renewal team explaining cause & mitigation. :thumbsup: 

mike_oncall: applied flag at 22:55 UTC (prod scope). monitoring stream shows error rate down ~85% in the first 10m. keeping an eye for regressions.

sophia_csm: perfect. once you confirm steady state (30–60m), send a 1–2 sentence summary and I'll update renewal owner.

jamie_cs: will do. follow-up: can leo export a 24h raw trace for the req_ids so we can attach to the support ticket? if retention limits block that, tell us what slice you can provide and we'll request a longer retention for this org temporarily.

leo_eng: I can export the 24h slice for the time window (22:00–23:00) with all delivery events for pioneerlane, but full raw payloads may be redacted; will include headers and status. upload ETA 30m.

jamie_cs: awesome — thanks everyone, looping back in 30m with the renewal note if stable.
